expected_tests.name: http::h2_transport::sync_worker_tests::h2_sync_worker_is_unentered_and_retains_outer_context
expected_tests.purpose: Actual Tokio blocking parent has a current Handle; the scoped child has none and a different thread identity; parent retains its original context after join.

expected_tests.name: http::h2_transport::sync_worker_tests::h2_sync_worker_expired_deadline_never_calls_work
expected_tests.purpose: An already-expired absolute deadline invokes no work and drops the captured affine owner once.

expected_tests.name: http::h2_transport::sync_worker_tests::h2_sync_worker_preserves_inner_result
expected_tests.purpose: A callback's inner Err value remains Ok(Err) at the helper boundary, not flattened into helper success or failure.

expected_tests.name: http::h2_transport::sync_worker_tests::h2_sync_worker_joins_panicked_work_and_drops_capture
expected_tests.purpose: A fixed synthetic unwind is joined and mapped to helper Err; owned capture is dropped exactly once.

expected_tests.name: http::h2_transport::sync_worker_tests::h2_sync_worker_does_not_authorize_nested_runtime_context
expected_tests.purpose: Entering a nested runtime inside the otherwise unentered child recreates the exact unchanged guard's refusal predicate. This component tests the predicate, not a fabricated native admission.

expected_tests.name: http::h2_transport::sync_worker_tests::h2_sync_worker_cancelled_waiter_retains_blocking_capacity
expected_tests.purpose: Cancelling the async waiter cannot free an occupied single blocking-pool slot; a queued probe only runs after the actual scoped child completes and its parent drops.

limitations: No component starts a product server, CLI, provider, network, native store, or original B01 fixture.
Nested context component checks the unchanged guard predicate; no claim that it directly calls the private HA-service guard.
OS thread-creation failure branch is statically before callback invocation; no artificial OS exhaustion or new production injection API is proposed.
New Rust source has not been formatted, compiled, linted or executed.

proposed_separate_increment.execution_owner: ha_validation prepares the unified controller; root reviews exact inputs and gives execution GO

actual_h1_h2_tls_and_cli_gate.preserve: Normal entry, original Phase B B01-B05 native archive and API/cold semantics; CLI/HTTP 15 seconds; action 300 seconds; readiness 45; election 60; forward 8; peer 1.5; TERM 5 and KILL 5; no replay of either old B01 UNKNOWN.
actual_h1_h2_tls_and_cli_gate.h1: Retain original HTTP/1 entry and verify actual strict-TLS requests on the new normal artifact under the original budget.
actual_h1_h2_tls_and_cli_gate.h2: Verify actual TLS ALPN h2 and actual H2 request dispatch; a current-thread runtime unit test alone is insufficient.
actual_h1_h2_tls_and_cli_gate.official_cli: Run the exact official 2.7.1 CLI against fresh normal native fixture with legal archive A/B and API plus cold verification; exit zero is not restore qualification.
actual_h1_h2_tls_and_cli_gate.alpn_observation: The old CLI fixture did not capture negotiated ALPN. A concrete passive, bounded, secret-safe ALPN observation must be reviewed before claiming that the fresh official CLI used H2. Until then, TLS CLI and separate actual-H2 evidence must stay distinct.
actual_h1_h2_tls_and_cli_gate.existing_alpn_test_scope: Real Rustls TLS 1.2/1.3 handshake and application delivery over a bounded record pump; it explicitly does not prove HTTP/2 Service dispatch or official CLI ALPN. It is not silently added to the proposed nine-test group.
